Corollary
[Interior smoothness] 1. ch8:8.11\group ch08-generalized-solutions If the coefficients of a strictly elliptic $L$ and the datum $f$ are in $C^\infty (\Omega )$, then every weak solution $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ of $Lu=f$ belongs to $C^\infty (\Omega )$.
Proof

\sketch Combine Theorem 8.10 with Sobolev embedding at successively higher orders.

□
